description.s: 独立静态 helper（armhf + arm64，无需 Python），提供 FTDI/OpenDMX、uDMX 16c0:05dc、Art-Net/sACN 多域输出。无需加载碟机面板即可自动从 stream-sync 读取 MASTER 碟机真实节拍相位（内存时钟，绝不写入 show.json；无播放轨时平滑回退手动 BPM），支持 Circle/8-Figure/Pan-Tilt Sweep、可选乐句切场（phraseBeats）与 24 PPQN ALSA MIDI Clock 输出。需显式启动 helper；实机灯具与 MIDI 外设待实机验证，通用灯库须按灯具手册核对。
description.t: 獨立靜態 helper（armhf + arm64，無須 Python），提供 FTDI/OpenDMX、uDMX 16c0:05dc、Art-Net/sACN 多域輸出。無須載入播放機面板即可自動從 stream-sync 讀取 MASTER 播放機真實節拍相位（記憶體時鐘，絕不寫入 show.json；無播放軌時平滑退回手動 BPM），支援 Circle/8-Figure/Pan-Tilt Sweep、可選樂句切場（phraseBeats）與 24 PPQN ALSA MIDI Clock 輸出。須明確啟動 helper；實機燈具與 MIDI 外設待實機驗證，通用燈庫須依燈具手冊核對。
description.e: Standalone static helper (armhf + arm64, no Python needed) for FTDI/OpenDMX, uDMX 16c0:05dc and multi-universe Art-Net/sACN. Reads the MASTER deck's live beat phase directly from stream-sync without requiring a deck panel (in-memory clock, never writes show.json; smooth manual BPM fallback), supporting Circle/8-Figure/Pan-Tilt Sweep, optional phrase scenes (phraseBeats) and 24 PPQN ALSA MIDI clock out. Start the helper explicitly. Fixture output, beat-synced shows and MIDI clock need real hardware validation; check generic profiles against the fixture manual.

summary.e: Map external USB MIDI controllers (Pioneer CDJ-400 first) to internal Deck 3/4.

description.s: 低优先级 (nice 19) ALSA Sequencer helper 与按需 60 Hz QML 桥接（未启用时零轮询），将外部 USB MIDI 控制器直接映射到四轨模式下的内部 Deck 3/4，无需切换硬件 Layer。含 CDJ-400 连续速度转盘积分器 (64=停止)、带 ▲▼ 指示的变速推子软接管、热拔插与 MIDI 风暴自动停用保护。CDJ-400 标准 USB MIDI 模式不接收外部 Note/CC LED 回传，状态与 ▲▼ 指示显示在屏幕上。需实机验证。
description.t: 低優先級 (nice 19) ALSA Sequencer helper 與按需 60 Hz QML 橋接（未啟用時零輪詢），將外部 USB MIDI 控制器直接映射至四軌模式下的內部 Deck 3/4，無須切換硬體 Layer。含 CDJ-400 連續速度轉盤積分器 (64=停止)、帶 ▲▼ 指示的變速推桿軟接管、熱拔插與 MIDI 風暴自動停用保護。CDJ-400 標準 USB MIDI 模式不接收外部 Note/CC LED 回傳，狀態與 ▲▼ 指示顯示於螢幕上。須實機驗證。
description.e: Low-priority (nice 19) ALSA Sequencer helper and on-demand 60 Hz QML bridge (zero polling when disabled) mapping external USB MIDI controllers directly to internal Deck 3/4 in 4-deck mode without switching hardware layers. Includes CDJ-400 continuous velocity jog time-integration (64=stop), tempo slider soft takeover with ▲▼ indicators, and hot-unplug/storm auto-disable. CDJ-400 in standard USB MIDI mode does not accept external MIDI Note/CC LED feedback; status and ▲▼ indicators are shown on screen. Hardware validation pending.
